authority: Verification component only. No protected execution, signed R2 result, qualification or whole-goal acceptance.

observedRouting.scope: Recorded queued-run metadata identifies the admitted callee; it proves neither execution nor success.

independentApproval.repository: Must equal the independently approved non-fork caller repository
independentApproval.source: Each caller/callee must match its own independent exact revision and ASCII file digest.

bounds.unchangedExternalTrial: 50 MiB / 200 Class A / 2000 Class B / ten minutes

controls: caller and callee may have different resolved commits
legacy approval constructor and JSON default to no reusable workflows
unknown callee denied before source fetch
wrong repository/path/ref/tag/revision denied before source fetch
missing SHA, duplicate and additional callees denied
duplicate and non-Heavy independent approvals denied
lossy Unicode and oversized files denied even with matching approval digest
combined exact 64 KiB accepted and one-byte overflow denied
complete private observation publication uses the same verification
second metadata read detects changed or removed resolution
independent approval snapshotted before metadata effects

regression.before: One intended failure: Run.referenced_workflows maximum length zero rejects the independently approved leaf.
regression.setupFailure: An earlier helper passed decoded optional fields to a decoder; corrected by schema encoding first. This is retained separately and is not regression proof.

focused.command: bun x vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/cache-hosted-producer.test.ts test/cache-producer.test.ts test/cache-workflow.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

docgen.scope: Scoped example typechecking. Exported example/signature text is unchanged by the later aggregate byte-budget guard.

verification.hooks: Normal source commit passed formatter, secrets scan, typos, JSDoc, instrumentation/schema catalog writers and commitlint.

packetDoctor.scope: Packet hygiene only; existing historical completion advisories retained.

remaining: Fresh hosted component CI and review
Real protected main source/tool inspection and independent runtime approval
Bounded live signed R2 publication, replay and authenticated acceptance
Trust negative cases and representative windows
Final whole-goal evidence, reflection and lifecycle
